sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-22 on akiendell: cairn superclaude exited 127 silently because the dispatcher ran a bash launcher and where.exe lists WSL's bash.exe first. superclaude.py (1941e93b25a3) exists; nothing dispatches to it, and _run starts every verb with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, which gives an interactive claude a hidden console instead of this one.
